subject: 5-Bullet Friday — Voice-to-Text That Works, Writing Rules and Routines from Masters, Miyazaki’s Creative Process, and More

bullets.title: Wispr Flow
bullets.note: From the homepage: “Effortless voice dictation in every application: 3x faster than typing, AI commands and auto-edits.” This came highly recommended by two friends, so I decided to give it a shot. Thus far, it’s far superior to other voice dictation that I’ve tried. For real prose, I continue to believe that deep thinking is the limiter and not any word-per-minute typing rate, but this is a great tool for banging out quick emails and messages.

bullets.title: Henry Miller’s 11 Commandments of Writing and His Daily Creative Routine
bullets.creator: Maria Popova
bullets.note:
.  
​  
For my personal reorientation towards book writing, I bolded a few as reminders:

1\. Work on one thing at a time until finished.  
2\. Start no more new books, add no more new material to ‘Black Spring.’  
3\. **Don’t be nervous. Work calmly, joyously, recklessly on whatever is in hand.  
​**4\. Work according to Program and not according to mood. **Stop at the appointed time!**​  
5\. When you can’t _create_ you can _work_.  
6\. Cement a little every day, rather than add new fertilizers.**  
​**7. **Keep human! See people, go places, drink if you feel like it.  
​**8. **Don’t be a draught-horse! Work with pleasure only.  
​**9\. Discard the Program when you feel like it—but go back to it next day. _**Concentrate. Narrow down. Exclude.**_**​  
​**10\. **Forget the books you want to write. Think only of the book you are writing.  
​**11\. **Write first and always.** Painting, music, friends, cinema, all these come afterwards.

bullets.title: “Ep. 1 Ponyo is Here” (10 Years with Hayao Miyazaki)
bullets.note: ](https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/en/shows/3004569/)**.** Hayao Miyazaki has been called “the Walt Disney of Japan,” but [he has said](https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ponyo/japanese-director-miyazaki-seeks-breakout-u-s-film-idUSTRE57B03T20090812/) the comparison isn’t accurate because Walt Disney was a business person, and he sees himself as “just a director.” Miyazaki’s Studio Ghibli has produced four of Japan's top-five most successful animated blockbusters, including my favorite movie, _Spirited Away_, and _Princess Mononoke_, which beat _The Lost World: Jurassic Park_ when they both hit the big screens in Japan. [This episodic series](https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/en/shows/10yearshayaomiyazaki/?type=tvEpisode) from NHK, the BBC of Japan, chronicles “the creative process of the legendary Japanese filmmaker. He is shown as a passionate artisan, a steadfast trailblazer, and a father butting heads with his son.”

bullets.title: “When I’m in writing mode for a novel, I get up at four a.m. and work for five to six hours. In the afternoon, I run for ten kilometers or swim for fifteen hundred meters (or do both), then I read a bit and listen to some music. I go to bed at nine p.m. I keep to this routine every day without variation. The repetition itself becomes the important thing; it’s a form of mesmerism. I mesmerize myself to reach a deeper state of mind.” — Haruki Murakami * * * You can complement this edition of 5-Bullet Friday with my brand-new interview with 2x Olympic Archery Medalist Jake Kaminski. bullets.title: Check out this incredible Indigenous craftwork
bullets.note:
[This gorgeous booklet](https://www.flipbookpdf.net/web/site/b4cd2732164afeb97ae449482330affe19b52cd8FBP35505366.pdf.html), which you can view online, is the result of a collaboration between yours truly and [LALO Tequila](https://lalospirits.com/?srsltid=AfmBOooYU_NwFrKXZLqjfGqeB0jOgoqn5H5NNFdA7AMDbyfASGPEQzTo). Each bottle is one of a kind and comes from the creative mind and inspired hands of a single Wixárika craftsman or craftswoman. The Wixárika people are one of the oldest known Indigenous groups still using peyote (hikuri) in a traditional context. This Lalo collaboration has already put more than $100,000 USD into the betterment of Wixárika communities, whose sacred lands are under threat from mining companies and other commercial interests. While the bottles are not for sale, I encourage you to learn more about this collaboration by [clicking here](https://www.instagram.com/p/DICKy78vTfo/?img_index=1).
